definitions.meaning: A life-salvation, life's safety, refuge, asylum

quotations.old_english: Cwom him to áre and to ealdor-nere
quotations.english: he come to them for mercy and for their life's salvation

source_text: ealdor-ner, aldor-ner, es; n. A life-salvation, life's safety, refuge, asylum; vitæ serv&a-long;tio, ref&u-short;gium :-- Cwom him to áre and to ealdor-nere he come to them for mercy and for their life's salvation, Exon. 53 b; Th. 189, 4; Az. 54. v. ner.
